title: Product Map: shape grouping
description: User story under REQ-170. a product reader reviewing the requirements chain the Product Map tab to bucket requirements by shapeClassification.shapes[], with an "Unclassified" bucket for REQs missing the classification and a "Business rules" bucket for the "none" shape
asA: a product reader reviewing the requirements chain
iWant: the Product Map tab to bucket requirements by shapeClassification.shapes[], with an "Unclassified" bucket for REQs missing the classification and a "Business rules" bucket for the "none" shape
soThat: I can see at a glance which requirements sit in each surface area (webUi, httpApi, auth, persistence, notifications, business rules) without reading every REQ body

acceptanceCriteria.description: The rendered review-surface HTML carries a "product-map" tab (data-tab="product-map") in tab order after Build sequence, with a hidden tabpanel id "tab-product-map" containing a shape-grouping section whose bucket headings enumerate every shape the classified REQs use plus "Unclassified" and "Business rules". A REQ classified into two shapes appears in both buckets. Rendering does not require a schema change.

Selecting the shape grouping drills each bucket to its REQs (rendered with the same doc-details helper and status pill as the Requirements tab), each REQ to its user stories, and each user story to its acceptance criteria, so the reader can go from a shape bucket to an AC in the same tab.
